gaps.rigs: CONTENT-full 7.2 #7: three rigs (hansom, landau, four-wheeler) are NOT shipped by any lane. Everything the STORY needs about them is computed from the chase lane's rail and is correct -- position, ground, scale, the 19.5->14.0 m gap, and which one the `cab` gate stands on. What is missing is only the picture, so each rig runs as its carriage lamp and its contact shadow. The chase lane's painted bloom (glow-lamp3) was tried and measured invisible at rig scale over warm cobbles, so the lamp is drawn as an emissive like every other light in this stack. Dropping set/chase/rig-<id>.png in gives them bodies with no engine change.
gaps.crowd: 7.2 #12: the crowd is not shipped. Beat VI stages the turn and the disperse on the street plate's own painted states (street-smoke / street-empty), which is where the crowd lives in the painting.
gaps.props: 7.2 #13: the gold watch is painted INTO norton-street.png; the ring is the church lane's painted church-ring.jpg; the hourglass is a shipped layer. The sovereign and the rocket are performed as light (engine-side emissives), not as sprites.
gaps.maid: 7.2 #12: folded into street-window.jpg, which is the ledger's own stated fallback.
gaps.clergyman: 7.2 #6: no cut shipped, and none is needed -- St Monica's paints its own clergyman and nothing in the beat moves him.
gaps.knot-patch: shipped but NOT USED: set/church/knot-patch.png is a harmonic blur, not a clean inpaint, and clipped over the groom it puts a grey smear in the chancel. sets/church.js keeps the painted groom instead and only shows the Norton sprite while he is off his own mark.
